Description.DefaultText: Hidden 0-3 counter: how many times the player has taken Captain Sterling's 'Think better of it' option instead of fighting him (Village_Master_Plan.md 10.8.11.9). Incremented declaratively by cmcEncounterGuardSterling's EscapeOptionStatChanges. At 3 the lenient finish-arrest duty stops being selectable and Duty_SterlingForceArrest takes over, which routes to cmcEncounterSterlingArrest -- ForceFight, no escape button. Reset to 0 by that encounter's PlayerDemoralizedEffects. Clamped 0-3 by MinMaxValue so it can never inflate past its own gate (the unclamped-repeatable-counter antipattern in the root CLAUDE.md).
